messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: GPU pool saturation in us-west1 causing request queue growth and 429 throttles. Severity: P2. Escalating to oncall.

emma (oncall): I'm on it. Observing sustained queue depth on renderer-gpu-us-west1, avg wait ~14s and token throttles. Any recent deploys?

mike (sre): No deploys flagged. Autoscaler logs show repeated scale attempts failing with quota errors: "VM quota exceeded for region us-west1". Max_nodes in policy is 80, current nodes 80.

natalie (infra): Confirming quota spike. We got a burst of inference load from multiple high-traffic customers. US-west1 GPU quota hit. Cross-region spillover to us-east1 started but traffic routing is conservative (weight 90% west, 10% east).

emma (oncall): Customers seeing 429s or long latencies?

ryan (product): Support reported 4 customers hitting timeouts. One is on dedicated reserved capacity but request routing still sent to hosted pool due to mis-routed endpoint.

mike (sre): Queue snapshot: pending tasks ~3.2k, processing throughput stalled. Autoscaler attempted node group expansion but GCE returned 403/QUOTA_EXCEEDED to provisioning requests.

emma (oncall): Immediate mitigation options: 1) expand quota (slow), 2) change routing policy to shift more traffic to us-east1, 3) enable emergency reserved pool for affected customers, 4) temporary rate-limit/queue thinning. I propose 2 + 3 now. Thoughts? :point_up:

natalie (infra): Agreed. I'll push routing change to increase east weight to 50% for inference-route-*. Doing a gradual shift but we can do immediate for critical tenants.

deploy-bot: Deploy started by natalie: routing-config/update weights -> us-east1:50% us-west1:50% (config-id: rc-2026-03-15-01)

emma (oncall): Natalie, can you also pin the affected tenants to their dedicated fallback pools? Ryan, can you confirm which tenants?

ryan (product): Tenants: acme-inc, bluewave, pixl.ai. Acme and Bluewave have reserved pools in us-east1. Pixl.ai is hosted only but can be routed. I'll DM support for specifics.

mike (sre): After routing push: ingress to us-east1 spiked as expected, queue in west dropped ~40% within 2 minutes. However, some long-running KV caches are miss-hitting in east causing cold-start latency for a subset.

emma (oncall): Acceptable for now. Keep me posted on errors. Also we need to address autoscaler config: max_nodes hard cap at 80 is too low for peak. Who owns that policy?

natalie (infra): That was set during cost-conservative rollout in June. We should increase to 150 for west and add overflow to dedicated pool. I can patch policy after routing stabilized.

mike (sre): Note: quota request to GCP for GPUs will take hours. For next-hour mitigation, we should 1) enable scheduled fallback route across additional regions (eu-west1 if latency tolerable), 2) unblock dedicated pool reservations.

emma (oncall): Agreed. Natalie: do (1) now. Mike: start reserved pool activation for acme-inc and bluewave. Ryan: coordinate messaging to support. I'll update incident commander channel.

natalie (infra): Pushing global routing: add eu-west1 as tertiary at 20% for low-priority shards (config-id rc-2026-03-15-02).

deploy-bot: Deploy started by natalie: routing-config/add eu-west1 20% for low-priority

mike (sre): Reserved pool activation in progress. For acme-inc: reserve-us-east1-acme -> success. bluewave reserved -> success. pixl.ai moved to hosted us-east1.

emma (oncall): Good. Reduce traffic to west further to 20% while autoscaler and quota get handled.

natalie (infra): Done. west:20 east:60 eu:20 (config-id rc-2026-03-15-03).

emma (oncall): Monitoring: token throttles dropped 85%, queue down to ~420 tasks, latencies recovering. Any customer-facing impact left?

ryan (product): Support: acme reported intermittent latency but no errors after switch. Pixl.ai reports degraded performance for 3 endpoints (we routed them to east, but they hit cold caches). Noted to product ops.

mike (sre): Autoscaler root cause: policy max_nodes + instance template zone constraints caused attempts to provision GPUs in a drained zone -> 'ZONE_RESOURCE_POOL_EXHAUSTED' for a subset. We need to loosen zoneAffinity and increase max_nodes.

emma (oncall): Action items: natalie increase max_nodes west->150 and remove strict zone affinity; mike file infra change to autoscaler policy and test; ryan coordinate CS messaging for pixl.ai and acme; I'll take incident lead for next 30m then hand off.

natalie (infra): Updating autoscaler policy now (patch id ap-2026-03-15-01). Will roll change into canary then global.

incident-bot: Incident update: Routing mitigation applied, reserved pools activated, autoscaler patch in progress. Severity remains P2.

emma (oncall): Handing off to mike (sre) for the next shift at 1825123600. Mike, you own remediation, follow-ups, and postmortem.

mike (sre): Taking over. Will validate autoscaler patch and confirm quota escalation ticket to cloud provider (ticket #GCP-99821). Will collect logs for PM.

emma (oncall): Thanks team. Quick retrospective notes: need emergency routing runbook, quota pre-warm playbook, and better detection for max_nodes saturation. Please add to postmortem. :memo:

ryan (product): I'll draft customer-facing status for Support and Marketing. ETA 30m.

mike (sre): Autoscaler patch applied to canary -> looks good. Will promote to global in 10m.

natalie (infra): Global autoscaler policy updated: max_nodes=150, zoneAffinity removed. Monitoring shows successful node provisioning requests accepted by provider.

incident-bot: Incident resolved for user-facing errors. Follow-up tasks assigned: PM, infra changes, runbook updates.

mike (sre): Postmortem owner assigned to me. Will include timeline, root cause (quota + conservative max_nodes + zone affinity), mitigation timeline, and action items.

emma (oncall): Closing active paging. If any new regressions, re-open. Great work. :tada:
